{"name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Drives the UEFN play-in-client play-test loop: start and stop a session, push content changes to the
connected server, and start, stop, and inspect the in-game match. Also reads the session's Verse output
(Print() and Verse runtime errors, via GetVerseOutput) and the launched client's own log (client-side engine
and gameplay warnings and errors, via GetClientLogEntries): the way to observe what the running game
actually did.","tools":[{"description":"Disconnect from and tear down the active play-in-client session.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.StopSession","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Stop the running in-game match on the connected server.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.StopGame","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome","enum":["Failed","Completed","StillRunning"],"description":"Whether the operation has completed or is still running."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Upload the open project and launch a play-in-client session.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.StartSession","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"location":{"description":"When set, launches via Play From Here: starts a match and spawns the player at this position once content finishes loading.","default":null,"title":"Vector","type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"number","default":0},"y":{"type":"number","default":0},"z":{"type":"number","default":0}}},"rotation":{"description":"Spawn orientation applied with Location; ignored when Location is unset.","default":null,"title":"Rotator","type":"object","properties":{"pitch":{"type":"number","description":"Cabeceo (grados) alrededor del eje Y.","default":0},"yaw":{"type":"number","description":"Guiñada (en grados) alrededor del eje Z.","default":0},"roll":{"type":"number","description":"Rodaje (en grados) alrededor del eje X.","default":0}}}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome","enum":["Failed","Completed","StillRunning"],"description":"Whether the operation has completed or is still running. Once complete, Verse output (Print and runtime errors) appears in GetVerseOutput."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Start the in-game match on the connected server.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.StartGame","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome","enum":["Failed","Completed","StillRunning"],"description":"Whether the operation has completed or is still running. Once complete, Verse output (Print and runtime errors) appears in GetVerseOutput."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Re-send modified project data to the connected server.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.PushChanges","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"bVerseOnly":{"type":"boolean","description":"Send only modified Verse source, skipping the asset cook a full push performs; much faster, so prefer it when only Verse changed.","default":false}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetAsyncOutcome","enum":["Failed","Completed","StillRunning"],"description":"Whether the operation has completed or is still running. Once complete, Verse output (Print and runtime errors) appears in GetVerseOutput."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Read the Verse output of the play-in-client session, as reported by the server (local or remote): Print()
output, Verse log messages, and Verse runtime errors with their callstack. Call this after StartSession,
PushChanges, or StartGame, and whenever the user reports unexpected runtime behavior, to check what the
Verse code actually did. Output from earlier sessions in this editor run is kept (latest 2000 entries). The
server sends at most about 100 entries per second, then a "Throttling replicated Verse log entries" warning.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.GetVerseOutput","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"Case-insensitive regular expression matched against Message; empty returns every entry.","default":""},"maxResults":{"type":"integer","description":"Maximum entries to return per call; must be >= 1.","default":100},"cursor":{"type":"integer","description":"Paging cursor: 0 reads from the oldest kept entry; pass the previous call's NextCursor to get the next page or only newer output.","default":0},"runId":{"type":"string","description":"The RunId from the previous call's result; empty on the first call. When it differs from the current run (the editor restarted), Cursor is ignored: reading restarts from the oldest kept entry and bCursorReset is true.","default":""}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"title":"SessionToolsetVerseOutput","description":"Matching entries, oldest first, plus RunId and the paging cursor (NextCursor, bHasMore). Empty Entries means no matching output yet (or no session), not an error. Raises if Pattern is not a valid regular expression, MaxResults < 1, or Verse output capture is unavailable in this editor.","type":"object","properties":{"entries":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"SessionToolsetVerseOutputEntry","type":"object","properties":{"sequence":{"type":"integer","description":"Increases by one per captured entry during this editor run.","default":0},"timestamp":{"type":"string","description":"When the entry was emitted, UTC, ISO 8601: server clock for Print() output, editor receive time for runtime errors.","default":""},"severity":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetVerseOutputSeverity","enum":["Debug","Verbose","Normal","Warning","Error"],"default":"Normal"},"channel":{"type":"string","description":"Log channel; empty for Print() output, "VerseRuntime" for runtime errors.","default":""},"message":{"type":"string","description":"The output text; for a runtime error, the full message including the Verse callstack; truncated to 16384 characters with a " [truncated]" suffix when longer.","default":""},"sourceFile":{"type":"string","description":"File name of the Verse source that emitted the entry; empty when unknown, always for runtime errors.","default":""},"sourceLine":{"type":"integer","description":"1-based line in SourceFile; 0 when unknown.","default":0}}},"description":"The matching entries, oldest first.","default":[]},"nextCursor":{"type":"integer","description":"Pass as Cursor to continue; entries up to this point have been processed. 0 when nothing was captured.","default":0},"runId":{"type":"string","description":"Identifies this editor run's capture; pass it back with NextCursor.","default":""},"bHasMore":{"type":"boolean","description":"True when more matching entries follow; call again with Cursor = NextCursor.","default":false},"bEntriesDropped":{"type":"boolean","description":"True when entries after Cursor were discarded before this call (only the latest 2000 are kept).","default":false},"bCursorReset":{"type":"boolean","description":"True when RunId differed from the current run or Cursor was newer than any captured entry (the editor
restarted), so reading restarted from the oldest kept entry.","default":false}}}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Get the connection status of the play-in-client session.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.GetSessionStatus","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetSessionStatus","enum":["Disconnected","Connecting","Reconnecting","Connected","UpdatingContent"],"description":"The current session connection status."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Get the state of the in-game match on the connected server.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.GetGameState","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","title":"ESessionToolsetGameState","enum":["CanStart","Running","Unconnected"],"description":"The current match state."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Search the log of the launched play-in-client client for a pattern, case-insensitively, by regex. It
holds client-side engine and gameplay output (warnings, errors, loading, networking). Verse Print()
output and Verse runtime errors run on the server and are NOT in this log; use GetVerseOutput for them.
Call this when the user reports client-side problems.","name":"ValkyrieFortniteToolset.SessionToolset.GetClientLogEntries","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"A regular expression matched against each line (e.g. "Error|Warning")."},"maxResults":{"description":"Maximum matches to return; unset means unlimited.","default":null,"type":"integer"},"startLine":{"type":"integer","description":"0-indexed line to start from; negative starts at the first line. Pass the previous call's LastEntryLine + 1 to resume and read only lines written since then.","default":0}},"required":["pattern"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"title":"SessionToolsetClientLogEntries","description":"The matching lines in file order, plus the last line processed, for resuming a later search. An empty Entries array means no line matched, not an error. Raises if Pattern is empty or not a valid regular expression, MaxResults < 1, or no client log exists yet (no session has been started).","type":"object","properties":{"entries":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"The matching log lines, in file order.","default":[]},"lastEntryLine":{"type":"integer","description":"Line number of the last line processed, for resuming a later search.","default":0}}}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}}]}
